  "pros": [
    "Effective for centralizing client and lead data, communication history, and activities.",
    "Offers good customization options for tracking specific data fields.",
    "Provides a comprehensive set of features for contact management at a reasonable price point."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Can have a learning curve, requiring time to set up and optimize for specific workflows.",
    "Occasional performance issues or minor technical limitations were encountered.",
    "Customer support response times or depth of solutions could sometimes be improved."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This engineer found Zoho CRM to be a capable solution for their contact management needs, appreciating its ability to centralize data and offer customization. While generally positive about its functionality and value, they noted that the initial setup and ongoing optimization required some effort. They also experienced occasional frustrations with performance and customer support efficiency."
